oneLine: Billionbrains Garage saw a block deal worth Rs 1,918 crore.
seller: Peak XV Partners Investments VI-1 and Sequoia Capital Global Fund III

sources.title: Billionbrains Garage Shares Slip 3% After ₹1,918 Cr Block Deal
Groww Parent Billionbrains Shares Fall 3% After Rs 1,999 Cr Block Deal
Peak XV sells 1.47% stake in Groww for Rs 1,756 Cr via bulk deal

synopsis: Billionbrains Garage Ventures, the parent company of the investment platform Groww, experienced a block deal valued at approximately ₹1,918.3 crore. Early-stage venture capital investors Peak XV Partners Investments VI-1 and Sequoia Capital Global Fund III sold a 1.6% stake, consisting of nearly 10.02 crore shares, at a price of ₹191.45 per share. The transaction caused the company's shares to slip by 3% in trading. The sold shares are subject to a 30-day lock-up period preventing further divestments by the sellers in this manner for the next month. The company recently posted a quarterly net profit of ₹735 crore for the first quarter of the 2027 fiscal year.
